verdict.rationale: Anytype exposes a local API, MCP server, and an 'agents skill' explicitly designed for AI agents to run scripts against Anytype data 'to handle bulk edits, transformations, and repetitive tasks' via tools like Claude Code/Cursor, which supports bulk operations through automation. However, this relies on third-party agent tooling rather than a native built-in bulk-edit UI/feature, and there's no first-party documentation or independent corroboration of actual bulk operations being performed at scale. missing for 10: native bulk-edit UI feature, hands-on/independent verification of bulk operations working at scale, performance/rate-limit details for large batch API calls.
